threaded_hole_finding.locator: Product Introduction > pbil-lis > pbil-lis-cont > pbil-lis-cont-tit; following pbil-lis-cont-word paragraph
threaded_hole_finding.heading_text: Different Versions of LF105 Threaded Hole
threaded_hole_finding.body_paraphrase: The product card directs readers to online customer service for more information.
threaded_hole_finding.interpretation: The base product page advertises multiple threaded-hole versions. It does not identify the selected version in the extracted text, so neither an M4 nor an M6 SKU is asserted.

corrections.finding: The explicit lithium iron phosphate description is on PDF page 1. The initial page 2 chemistry locator was inaccurate.
corrections.observed_current_locator: PDF page 1: introductory description explicitly names lithium iron phosphate chemistry (LiFePO4)

corrections.finding: The LF105 product introduction advertises multiple threaded-hole versions without an identified selected hardware version in the extracted text. A standard terminal variant would overstate source applicability.

limitations: No legal factory identity, connector dimensions, weight, maintenance interval or school inventory condition was independently verified in this review.
A manufacturer-labelled nominal energy was retained only when explicitly printed. No capacity graph or voltage-times-capacity calculation was substituted for a source rating.
The LF105 HTML was read, but its linked feature-image pixels were not examined. Image-only terminal dimensions or identifiers remain unverified.
The source pages were accessed on the recorded date; no claim is made that they are the newest published revisions.
